name: jc-code
description: Code-related skills vetted by John. Skills: drawio (generate .drawio diagrams and export PNG/SVG/PDF via the draw.io desktop CLI); mermaid (author and repair Mermaid diagrams, validated by rendering with mermaid-cli); guided-review (guide human judgments of an existing Review JSON with an overview table and detailed Finding cards); claude-setup (install John's preferred Claude Code machine setup, currently the status line script and its settings.json wiring); grilling (stress-test plans and ideas through focused questions); grill-with-docs (run a grilling session and create domain docs); domain-modeling (build and sharpen a project's domain model and record architectural decisions); interactive-design (walk a fuzzy small-to-medium build request through interview, vocabulary, and consequences to a short written design saved in the repo).
